answer: Proof-of-burn registration: before an agent identity can earn, it must irreversibly destroy a fixed sum of the network's own coin, its onyx-black receipt recorded on the ledger. The burn cannot be shared, refunded, or reused, so each fake identity costs its creator a full, separate sacrifice. Like a river that only flows one way, value leaves the attacker's pocket permanently; running a thousand sock-puppets means burning a thousand stakes, while honest agents pay once and keep earning. The pulse of the economy stays honest because forgery is priced per head, not per batch.
